scope.bootstrap: paired round indices within each case; fixed case grid geometric mean; percentile 95%; no case resampling
scope.server_validation: EXPLAIN planning+execution for existing artifact assertions, plus separately observed AF guard DO body execution; DO compilation/statement overhead unobserved
scope.profile_audit: bound SQL, intrinsic profile/contract identities and actual execution environments checked; upstream issuer preimages and general concurrent authorization not independently certified
scope.wrapper_audit: new resolved protocol wrapper and explicit override checked against exact bound SQL; no manifest rerendering or issuer substitution; legacy absent declarations retained as unrecorded
scope.normal_entry_check: only explicitly requested guarded normal executions are audited; each is separate from formal samples and independent canonical correctness; recorded script hash has no retained script preimage and is not reconstructed from today's issuer
scope.identical_sql: exact text groups are descriptive; all ordinary baseline comparisons retain their own unpooled samples
scope.timed_result_count: raw query EXPLAIN root Actual Rows, one loop and no parallel plan; compared with full reference row count; unavailable root counters recorded separately; no internal aggregate or child rows substituted
scope.fastest_applicable: post hoc minimum mode median over AF and all available ordinary baselines; descriptive, not an implemented selector
scope.choice_breakdown: exclusive category medians are separate observations and need not sum to the median total; inclusive categories are not additive
scope.recovery: separate SQL, observed-server and client point estimates using same-metric measured saving and recorded preparation costs; requires reuse; no confidence guarantee or unimplemented caching assumed; initialization exclusions remain as declared
scope.sampling_balance: AF/IP raw positions equal; ordinary external predecessor/successor labels equal by orientation; actual AF/IP carryover and transition matrix symmetric under AF<->IP relabeling
scope.sampling_cache_conditions: adjacency changes immediate predecessor/cache conditions; keep separate from legacy samples; no pooling or correction
scope.cycle_sensitivity: cycle indices are per case; at minimum30 n5 has four cycles and n6/n7 three; an extra mixed cycle may be a subset, identified by case_count; primary GM retains the full case grid
